\[
I_{\text{out}}(x,y) = \Bigl(\prod_{(s,t) \in S_{xy}} I(s,t)\Bigr)^{1/n}
= \exp\Bigl(\frac{1}{n} \sum_{(s,t) \in S_{xy}} \ln I(s,t)\Bigr)
\]

The formula shows the default parameter values.

where

- \(S_{xy}\): The window around pixel (x, y)
- \(n\): Number of values in the window

The product of the n window values, to the power 1 / n. It runs as the exponential of the mean of the logarithms, which does not overflow. If any value in the window is 0, the product is 0, so the output is 0.
